checks.name: all ten rules, eight cases, 36 synthetic patients
automation rerun and reload never duplicate tasks
D+1/D+3/D+7 from completed protocol sessions only
expected visit overdue is 14 days with doctor source
unfinished six-session plan and sixty-day gap
no-show and cancellation older than 24h without future booking
dormant90/180 are exclusive per customer
birthday window handles year boundary and excludes past birthdays
resolve persists one activity, timeline and metrics
callback requires next action and reschedules without duplicate
booking validates conflicts before atomic CRM resolution
booking links appointment and expected visit without fake reactivation
booking mismatch, missing note and duplicate task are rejected
opt-out suppresses marketing, retains clinical tasks and trace
reaction / complaint escalates to clinical inbox, never auto-reviewed
failed storage rolls back appointment, task, activity and expected date
reset produces identical tasks/metrics regardless of activities
legacy migration preserves clinical and payment history
payment and CRM do not approve draft prescriptions or complete sessions
new protocol completion schedules future D+1/3/7 without adding them to due queue
recall respects actual 24-hour boundary, not calendar day alone
cancel booked appointment returns expected visit to saved recommendation
